name: sad_01
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: કંઈ વાંધો નહીં, બધું સારું થઈ જશે.
gloss: No worries, everything will be fine.
speaker: Ira

name: sad_02
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: મન ખરાબ હોય ત્યારે થોડો સમય પોતાને આપ. હું અહીં જ છું.
gloss: When your heart is heavy, give yourself some time. I'm right here.
speaker: Ira

name: sad_03
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: તમે એકલા નથી, હું તમારી સાથે છું.
gloss: You are not alone, I'm with you.
speaker: Ira

name: sad_04
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: રડવું હોય તો રડી લે, પછી હળવું લાગશે.
gloss: If you need to cry, cry; you'll feel lighter after.
speaker: Ira

name: sad_05
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: આ સમય પણ નીકળી જશે.
gloss: This time will pass too.
speaker: Ira

name: sad_06
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: જે થયું એ થયું, હવે એક ડગલું આગળ.
gloss: What's done is done; now one step forward.
speaker: Ira

name: stressed_01
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: ચિંતા ના કર, એક પછી એક બધું થઈ જશે.
gloss: Don't worry, it will all get done one by one.
speaker: Ira

name: stressed_02
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: ઊંડો શ્વાસ લે, થોડી વાર શાંત થા.
gloss: Take a deep breath, calm down for a moment.
speaker: Ira

name: stressed_03
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: જ્યારે બધું ભારે લાગે, ત્યારે એક નાનું કામ પહેલા પતાવી દે.
gloss: When everything feels heavy, finish one small task first.
speaker: Ira

name: stressed_04
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: તૈયારી તો થઈ ગઈ છે, બાકી ઉપરવાળા પર છોડી દે.
gloss: The preparation is done; leave the rest to the Almighty.
speaker: Ira

name: stressed_05
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: થોડો આરામ કર, પછી ફરી જોઈશું.
gloss: Rest a little, we'll look again after.
speaker: Ira

name: stressed_06
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: હું છું ને, ચિંતા ના કર.
gloss: I'm here, don't worry.
speaker: Ira

name: angry_01
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: ગુસ્સો આવે એ સ્વાભાવિક છે, પણ થોડી વાર શાંત થા.
gloss: Anger is natural, but calm down for a bit.
speaker: Ira

name: angry_02
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: ચાલ, આ વાત પછી જોઈશું, અત્યારે મગજ ઠંડું રાખ.
gloss: Come on, we'll look at this later; keep a cool head for now.
speaker: Ira

name: angry_03
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: દુનિયા તો આવી જ છે, તું તારું કામ કર.
gloss: The world is like this; you just do your work.
speaker: Ira

name: happy_01
description: warm, cheerful, Gujarati accent, steady pace
text: વાહ, બહુ સરસ સમાચાર!
gloss: Wow, wonderful news!
speaker: Ira

name: happy_02
description: warm, cheerful, Gujarati accent, steady pace
text: અભિનંદન! આજે તો ઉજવણી બને છે.
gloss: Congratulations! Today deserves a celebration.
speaker: Ira

name: happy_03
description: warm, cheerful, Gujarati accent, steady pace
text: તારી મહેનત રંગ લાવી.
gloss: Your hard work paid off.
speaker: Ira

name: happy_04
description: warm, cheerful, Gujarati accent, steady pace
text: સાંભળીને બહુ આનંદ થયો.
gloss: I'm really glad to hear that.
speaker: Ira

name: excited_01
description: warm, upbeat, Gujarati accent, steady pace
text: વાહ, હવે તો મજા આવશે!
gloss: Wow, now it's going to be fun!
speaker: Ira

name: excited_02
description: warm, upbeat, Gujarati accent, steady pace
text: બહુ જ સરસ, બધું તૈયાર રાખજે.
gloss: Very nice, keep everything ready.
speaker: Ira

name: general_01
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: જે હોય તે, હું સાંભળું છું.
gloss: Whatever it is, I'm listening.
speaker: Ira

name: general_02
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: સારું, મેં યાદ રાખ્યું છે.
gloss: Okay, I've remembered it.
speaker: Ira

name: general_03
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: ચિંતા નહીં, જીવન છે, ચાલ્યા કરે.
gloss: No worries, that's life, it goes on.
speaker: Ira

name: general_04
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: ખાધું કે નહીં? કંઈક ખાઈ લે.
gloss: Did you eat? Have something.
speaker: Ira

name: general_05
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: થોડું ચાલી આવ, સારું લાગશે.
gloss: Go for a short walk, you'll feel better.
speaker: Ira

name: general_06
description: warm, gentle, Gujarati accent, slow pace
text: બધું સારું થઈ જશે, ભરોસો રાખ.
gloss: Everything will be fine, have faith.
speaker: Ira
